source:
field() {
    printf '%s\n' "$1" | cut -d , -f "$2"
}
before=$(cat before.csv)
after=$(cat after.csv)
first_boot=$(field "$before" 1)
first_name=$(field "$before" 2)
first_time=$(field "$before" 3)
first_rx=$(field "$before" 4)
first_tx=$(field "$before" 5)
last_boot=$(field "$after" 1)
last_name=$(field "$after" 2)
last_time=$(field "$after" 3)
last_rx=$(field "$after" 4)
last_tx=$(field "$after" 5)
if test "$first_boot" != "$last_boot" || test "$first_name" != "$last_name"; then
    printf 'Different source\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
elapsed=$((last_time - first_time))
if test "$elapsed" -le 0; then
    printf 'Invalid interval\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
if test "$last_rx" -lt "$first_rx" || test "$last_tx" -lt "$first_tx"; then
    printf 'Counter reset\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
rx=$(((last_rx - first_rx) * 1000 / elapsed))
tx=$(((last_tx - first_tx) * 1000 / elapsed))
printf '%s rx=%s B/s tx=%s B/s\n' "$last_name" "$rx" "$tx"

last_boot=$(field "$after" 1)

if test "$first_boot" != "$last_boot" || test "$first_name" != "$last_name"; then
    printf 'Different source\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
elapsed=$((last_time - first_time))
if test "$elapsed" -le 0; then
    printf 'Invalid interval\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
if test "$last_rx" -lt "$first_rx" || test "$last_tx" -lt "$first_tx"; then
    printf 'Counter reset\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
rx_change=$((last_rx-first_rx))
tx_change=$((last_tx-first_tx))
bytes_per_second() { printf '%s\n' "$(( $1 * 1000 / $2 ))"; }
rx=$(bytes_per_second "$rx_change" "$elapsed")
tx=$(bytes_per_second "$tx_change" "$elapsed")
printf '%s rx=%s B/s tx=%s B/s\n' "$last_name" "$rx" "$tx"
